assessment: This manuscript demonstrates that male mice lacking androglobin, a poorly understood heme-containing protein, are infertile and have defects in late stage spermatogenesis. The revisions are thorough and the inclusion of additional data makes the manuscript solid. The lack of defects at the hypothalamus-pituitary level makes the phenotype more striking as a direct effect of the mutation at the testis level. Overall, this revised version is significantly improved.
